name: Delta
desc:
Delta is Canor NPC. He works for [The Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union).

Delta is responsible for handing out Arc Suits, though he doesn't entirely understand the mechanics behind their function. Still, he's aware of the basics of Oaths and doesn't appreciate damaging the suits.

The Pathfinder is required to speak with him to obtain and progress the Arcwarder Oath after they rescue [Epsi](entity:epsi) and speak with [Alpha](entity:alpha).

He wears the Union Initiate Outfit.
